general_information.Description: This course provides a foundation for the understanding and analysis of information systems in organizations. It presents fundamental knowledge about the role that information systems play in businesses, how to design and build an appropriate information system and how to effectively manage the business’ information resources.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Class attendance is strongly encouraged. Attend more than 80% of class hours in order to be accepted to the final examination - Actively participate in class activities - Fulfil tasks given by intructor after class - Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose - Read the textbook in advance - Access the course website (http://cms.fpt.edu.vn) for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online supports from teachers and other students and for practicing and assessment.

description: This course provides a foundation for the understanding and analysis of information systems in organizations. It presents fundamental knowledge about the role that information systems play in businesses, how to design and build an appropriate information system and how to effectively manage the business’ information resources.

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Explain why information systems are essential to business
Able to make decision to choose suitable technologies to manage and develop business.
Having fundamental knowledge about network system, ERP, CRM, SCM, TPS, MIS, BIS, ESS, DMS, E-commerce and others.
Updating the history of technology and trends of technology development.

assessments.Note: Participation grade will be given based on students' attendance, preparation, and quantity as well as quality of participation in classroom; quality of participation is demonstrated through asking relevant questions, making statements that add to and facilitate class discussion, and builds upon others’ comments.

assessments.Knowledge and Skill: The management decision problems will be selected to examine students' ability to apply the course's knowledge to solve real-world managerial problems.

assessments.No Question: Maximum length of the group assignment should be 10 pages excluding appendices
assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Based on knowledge of all chapters
assessments.Note: All assignments should be typed and double-spaced with 12-point font, and must be submitted in both soft and hard copy. A deduction of 10% of the assignment mark will be applied for each day of late submission Evaluation will be based on both presentation and written report (reccommded 30%, 70% accordingly)

assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Quizzes will test for knowledge of subjects in the chapters assigned for that day.
assessments.Note: These quizzes will be given at the beginning of sessions. Total number of quizzes: 2

assessments.Question Type: Multiple choice. Other types of questions may be included.
assessments.Knowledge and Skill: The MC questions will cover knowledge of the whole course with a particular emphasis on knowledge of chapters that are not covered in quizzes (chapters 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15).
assessments.Note: Students are not allowed to use any document/information in any form in exam room
